decisions.decision:
Build it now. Go is decided, skip is rejected. Copy workshop-plan/crm-starter to a private reference folder that is never published, and run prompts 01 to 06 exactly as written.

Keys: only reuse test-mode keys that already exist.
- Resend: resend_api_key in ~/.config/tantra/r5F-readonly-keys.json, sending only to [email] as "Adi test".
- Dodo: look for a test-mode key in the tantra-redesign app env files (.env.local, .dev.vars) and in ~/.config/tantra/keys.
- Cal.com and Twilio: no account exists, so feed intake a recorded Cal.com webhook payload locally. Skip Twilio.

Capture #5 (runner.py --dry-run, next 24h) and #6 (board at localhost:8765 with test deals). Capture #4 too if a Dodo test key exists. Otherwise build and test payments.py against a Dodo test-mode payload fixture, and open a separate input task for the key.

Update the README status table only for prompts that worked as written, and fix the prompts that didn't. Log anything created in scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md and delete it afterwards. No n8n.
